judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a main structure for a wooden fruit stall, including a counter.
Add a red and white striped canopy over the stall, supported by two vertical wooden posts.
Display exactly four different, recognizable fruits.
requirements.note: Six fruit kinds are shown, not exactly four: oranges, red apples, purple grapes, yellow lemons, yellow bananas and watermelons.

requirements.text: First fruit: A pile of red apples in a wicker basket on the left side of the counter.
requirements.note: The apple pile is on the left of the counter as required, but it stands in a plain rectangular wooden crate (flat brown fill with a border and one plank line), not a wicker basket.

requirements.text: Second fruit: A bunch of yellow bananas placed next to the apples.
requirements.note: The banana bunch sits at the right end of the counter (around x=880, y=665) while the nearest apples are the shelf pile at about (730,510); the lemon crate at about (760,625) and the grape bowl at about (890,500) both lie between them and are both closer to the apples than the bananas are (about 119 px and 160 px against about 216 px), so the bananas are not placed next to the apples.

requirements.text: Third fruit: A pile of oranges in another wicker basket on the right side of the counter.
requirements.note: The oranges are in the CENTRE crate of the counter and centre of the shelf, not on the right side of the counter; the only orange crate on the right stands on the ground beside the stall rather than on the counter, and both are plain wooden crates, not wicker baskets.

requirements.text: Fourth fruit: A single, large slice of watermelon resting directly on the counter in the center.
requirements.note: The watermelons - two whole and one cut - lie on the GROUND in front of the counter and left of centre, not resting directly on the counter in the centre, and the cut one is a small round cross-section rather than a single large slice.

requirements.text: Include a character representing the stall vendor, a smiling man with a mustache, positioned behind the counter and between the baskets.
requirements.note: The vendor is a smiling man behind the counter, but at 5x his face carries only two dot eyes and a smile arc - there is no moustache anywhere on it.

requirements.text: Add a small, hanging chalkboard sign from the canopy that reads 'Fresh Fruit'.
requirements.note: The chalkboard reads 'FRESH FRUIT' over '$2 / KG' legibly in chalk lettering, but it is screwed flat to the counter's front panel (two screw dots at its top corners) below the counter top; nothing connects it to the canopy, so it does not hang from the canopy.

requirements.text: Depict a cobblestone ground surface in front of the stall.
requirements.note: The ground is flat sand carrying sparse, widely spaced outlined ellipses with bare sand between them - scattered pebble outlines rather than a packed paving-stone surface; no joint lines or tiled stones are drawn.

requirements.text: Include the silhouette of another market stall in the background to suggest a larger market setting.
